description: This Java class, AuthenticationResultWaiter, manages waiting for an asynchronous AuthenticationResult, with a timeout that results in an exception if exceeded. It implements Supplier to provide CompletableFuture<AuthenticationResult> and encapsulates handling of asynchronous authentication results with timeout logic.

classes.name: AuthenticationResultWaiter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that waits for an authentication result, with a predefined timeout, returning a future that either completes with the result or throws an exception on timeout.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AuthenticationResultWaiter instance with given future and headers, using default timeout.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture for the authentication result, with a timeout that throws an exception if exceeded.
